name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Fairburn GA

fieldNotes.buildingIdentity: Confirmed via web research: 907,665 sq ft speculative building (Red Rock Developments / LXP Industrial Trust), dimensions 650' x 1,400', in Shugart Farms Lake Industrial Park along I-85, leased to GXO. Satellite shows the matching large NW-SE-oriented building at the geocoded point.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open site. Street View (2025-11) shows the SW dock face and truck court with NO perimeter fence, NO gate barrier, and NO guard booth - a pickup truck drives freely past the dock apron. Access roads run open to the docks. truckGate / guardShack / remoteGs all false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors run the full ~1,400-ft SW building face with trailers backed in (FedEx and others visible in Street View). Solidly 50+; dockDoorCount ~115 estimated.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single dock bank on the SW face only; the NE long face is employee parking against a tree line with no docks. Not separate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in the SW truck court without tractors - a modest 10-25 band; trailerParkingCapacity ~60.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Very deep SW truck court (185-ft+ truck court typical of this build class) easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Shugart Farms Lake Industrial Park, surrounded by other large DCs and a residential subdivision to the SE, 12 miles south of Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport - dense metro-Atlanta industrial fabric. Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box ~456m N-S x ~464m E-W ≈ 52 acres.

citations.claim: GXO permanently ceased operations at its Fairburn GA facility, laid off all 69 employees (WARN Jan 8); separations Mar 10 2024

verification.rationale: WARN-backed trade press confirms GXO permanently ceased operations at Fairburn and laid off all staff Mar 2024.
verification.reason: GXO permanently ceased operations and laid off all 69 employees (WARN Jan 2024, closed ~Mar 2024).
